subject: GeoNext MAP: hosting, region, and procurement timeline
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@geonext.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: hosting questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the intro call this morning. A few constraints from our side that should drive the MAP and evaluation plan:

- Data classification: all payloads for our clinical routing product will be PHI (HIPAA scope).
- Region requirement: production must be in the US (preferred us-east) due to payor contracts; APAC not an option.
- Audit/compliance: we need SOC 2 evidence, and an answers workbook for our security questionnaire.
- Timeline: procurement team expects a 6-week window for contract/POC signoff if terms are standard; longer if we need on-prem work.

Can you share a proposed MAP (milestones + owners) that covers Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private paths, with an estimate of time-to-POC and required artifacts for procurement/legal?

Also copying our procurement contact: procure@geonext.com for visibility.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
VP Product, GeoNext Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@geonext.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@geonext.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: hosting questions

Hi Samira — really helpful context, thanks.

I attached a first-draft MAP that lays out two parallel paths:
1) Hosted (API) POC -> Dedicated reserve for production (recommended for most customers)
2) Private (VPC/on-prem) if geofence + contractual controls require it.

High level estimates (rough):
- Hosted POC (us-east): 2 weeks to instrument, 1 week to run benchmarks.
- Dedicated reservation + SLA: additional 2–4 weeks for capacity reservation and SSO/KMS integration.
- Private deployment: 6–10+ weeks depending on network setup and certificate exchange.

I'll pull together the SOC2 workbook and pricing redline for procurement. Proposed next steps:
- Confirm desired POC region (us-east) and target latency SLO.
- Agree MAP milestones and owners (I propose Redwood: Ben/Karthik; GeoNext: Samira/Alex).
- Schedule a 30-min procurement sync w/ procurement team this week.

Attaching: GeoNext_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP draft)

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@geonext.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@geonext.com>

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: hosting questions

Thanks Ben. Procurement here — two quick asks so our finance/legal can move fast:

1) Can you provide a pricing redline (PDF) with committed throughput tiers and overage rates? We typically negotiate 12-month reserved capacity for production.
2) SOC2 evidence + answers to the attached security questionnaire (we prefer an editable workbook).

If you can get both to us by EOD Friday, we can slot the contract review on our side and keep the 6-week target.

–Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@geonext.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@geonext.com>, procure@geonext.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP kickoff: hosting questions — GeoNext (GN-4821)

Forwarding GeoNext thread — they want a firm MAP and pricing redline to meet a 6-week procurement window. Key asks: us-east deployment, SOC2 workbook, pricing redline with reserved tiers.

Internal ask: can we land the following by Fri?
- SOC2 workbook answers (Marissa) — attach SOC2_Qs_GeoNext.xlsx
- Pricing redline with 12-month reserved tier and migration credits for POC (Laura) — attach pricing_redline_20270620.pdf
- Technical recommendation for POC -> prod path (Karthik) — quick doc: Hosted POC in us-east, Dedicated for production, fallback to Private only if contractual geofence demands.

I propose we recommend Hosted POC (fastest to benchmark) and a Dedicated reservation for production to provide isolation + SLA. Private/on-prem should be scoped only if legal insists.

Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP kickoff: hosting questions — GeoNext (GN-4821)

Agree with Ben's suggested path. Quick technical notes to include in the MAP and hand to the GeoNext infra team: 

- POC (Hosted, us-east):
  * Timeline: 2 weeks prep + 1 week run (benchmarks + sample traffic)
  * Requirements: test dataset that mirrors PHI (tokenization + redaction guidance), VPC peering option, KMS integration for customer-managed keys (if required).
  * Measurements: p95 latency, token cost per 10k, cold-starts, KV cache hit-rate.

- Production (Dedicated):
  * Benefits: predictable throughput, reserved GPU capacity, network isolation.
  * Integrations: SAML SSO, KMS, audit log forwarding (syslog), retention policy controls.
  * Lead time: 2–4 weeks after POC depending on quotas.

- Private (VPC/on-prem):
  * Consider only if contract explicitly forbids multi-tenant hosting. Expect 6–10+ weeks, ops runbook + install window.

Next steps I can own: prepare a short technical annex for the MAP that lists exact network/KMS steps and a sample benchmark script. Will attach by EOD Friday.

–Karthik
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@geonext.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@geonext.com>, procure@geonext.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 00:45:00 -0700
Subject: GeoNext MAP: hosting, region, and procurement timeline

Samira / Alex — thanks for the quick follow ups last week. Per our internal alignments, attaching the updated MAP and artifacts and proposing the milestones below so we can keep to your 6-week procurement window.

Attachments included: GeoNext_MAP_v2.pdf; SOC2_Qs_GeoNext.xlsx; pricing_redline_20270620.pdf

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP and pricing redline — Redwood (Ben/Laura) / GeoNext (Samira/Alex)
- Week 1: Hosted POC in us-east: data prep, KMS & VPC peering test — Redwood (Karthik) / GeoNext infra
- Week 2: Run benchmarks and quality evals; collect latency/cost numbers — Redwood + GeoNext
- Week 3: Procurement & legal review pricing redline; finalize SOW and security addendum — GeoNext procurement + Redwood legal
- Week 4: If production path selected = Dedicated reservation provisioning; if contract requires Private, begin install planning (lead time 6+ weeks).

Decision gate: after Week 2 benchmarks we will choose Hosted->Dedicated (preferred) or Private (if contract/legal requires).

Requested commitments from GeoNext to hit the timeline:
- Provide security questionnaire responses (completed workbook) by Thu, Jun 24.
- Confirm POC test dataset and a single point of contact for infra tasks.
- Procurement to confirm target go-live month and preferred billing cadence.

I'll schedule a 30-minute checkpoint for Thu Jun 24 10:00am PT to review the workbook and the MAP. Let me know if that time conflicts.

Thanks — we'll keep the MAP living in the shared Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/GeoNext/MAP-v2

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
